faq.title: Questions? We have answers.
questions: Can I apply to several internships?
Yes, as long as you don't have an active internship. As soon as an offer is accepted, your other pending applications are automatically deactivated.
Can companies see my contact details?
No. Your direct contact details are only visible to the company once your internship is activated, after the agreement is accepted.
Is InternIn free?
Yes, InternIn is entirely free for interns.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
questions: How much does it cost to post an internship offer?
Posting offers is free to start. A freemium model with advanced options is available for companies wanting more visibility.
How do I find the right interns?
Use our matching filters (skills, availability, interests) or invite verified profiles directly.
Can I invite students directly?
Yes, you can browse verified profiles and directly invite candidates you're interested in to an interview.
How does the interview process work?
Interviews are scheduled and conducted directly on the platform, with Google Meet integration and automatic reminders.
Can I convert an intern into a full-time employee?
Yes, at the end of the internship you can recommend and offer full-time employment directly through the platform.

faq.title: We have answers.
questions: How can my university become an InternIn partner?
Contact our team via the "Become a partner" button to set up your institution on the platform.
How do students get started?
Once your university is onboarded, you invite your students, who then create their profile to search for internships.
Can we track student performance and feedback?
Yes, a dedicated dashboard lets you track your students' progress, weekly evaluations, and outcomes in real time.
What kinds of companies are on InternIn?
All companies are verified by our team before they can publish internship offers.
Is there a cost for universities?
The basic partnership is free. Contact us to discuss advanced reporting and support options.

missionStory.title: Training future-ready professionals across Africa
paragraphs: InternIn was created to close the gap between education and employment. Too many students graduate without hands-on experience, while companies struggle to identify and develop emerging talent.

We're changing that by making internships structured, measurable, and geared toward professional development. Our platform brings together students, universities, and employers to create enriching internship experiences, backed by mentorship, accountability, and AI-assisted professional development.
Because every student deserves the chance to gain real experience before entering the job market.
